nodes.label: Indian Contract Act: guarantee, indemnity, pledge, lien
nodes.title: Indian Contract Act, 1872: contracts of indemnity and guarantee (ss. 124-147), bailment, bankers' lien and pledge (ss. 148-181), and related general provisions

nodes.label: Sale of Goods Act: title to goods financed
nodes.title: Sale of Goods Act, 1930: passing of property, transfer of title and the unpaid seller's rights

nodes.label: Transfer of Property Act: mortgages, charges, assignment of debts
nodes.title: Transfer of Property Act, 1882: mortgages and charges of immovable property (ss. 58-104) and transfer of actionable claims (ss. 130-137)
nodes.group: Mortgages, property and goods as security

nodes.label: Indian Trusts Act: trusts used in lending structures
nodes.title: Indian Trusts Act, 1882: creation of trusts, duties of trustees and breach of trust
nodes.group: Mortgages, property and goods as security

nodes.label: Aircraft Objects Act 2025: Cape Town security interests
nodes.title: Protection of Interests in Aircraft Objects Act, 2025: gives the Cape Town Convention and Aircraft Protocol the force of law in India
nodes.group: Mortgages, property and goods as security
nodes.status: Enacted: comes into force on the date the Central Government notifies

nodes.label: SARFAESI Act: enforcing security without court
nodes.title: Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest Act, 2002

nodes.label: RDB Act: Debts Recovery Tribunals
nodes.title: Recovery of Debts and Bankruptcy Act, 1993 (formerly the Recovery of Debts Due to Banks and Financial Institutions Act)

nodes.label: Tribunals Reforms Act 2026: DRT, DRAT and consumer commissions
nodes.title: Tribunals Reforms Act, 2026: s. 6 substitutes ss. 6A and 15A of the RDB Act; s. 12 substitutes s. 55(1A) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

nodes.label: Limitation Act: time limits for recovery suits
nodes.title: Limitation Act, 1963: periods for suits on loans, guarantees, promissory notes and mortgages, and fresh periods on acknowledgement or part-payment

nodes.label: Specific Relief Act: specific performance and injunctions
nodes.title: Specific Relief Act, 1963 (as amended in 2018): specific performance, substituted performance and injunctions

nodes.label: NI Act: cheque bounce (s. 138)
nodes.title: Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881: promissory notes, bills and cheques, and the offence of cheque dishonour (Chapter XVII, ss. 138-148)

nodes.label: Indian Stamp Act: duty on loan and security documents
nodes.title: Indian Stamp Act, 1899: stamp duty on loan agreements, mortgages, pledges, hypothecations and guarantees, and the effect of under-stamping
nodes.status: In force (as amended, with State amendments)

nodes.label: Maharashtra Stamp Act: title-deed deposits and mortgages
nodes.title: Maharashtra Stamp Act (Bom. Act 60 of 1958), Schedule I: Article 6 (agreement relating to deposit of title deeds, pawn, pledge or hypothecation), Article 40 (mortgage deed) and Article 54 (security bond or mortgage deed)

nodes.label: Other State stamp schedules: Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Tamil Nadu
nodes.title: State stamp schedules for loan and security documents: Delhi (Schedule I-A), Uttar Pradesh (Schedule I-B) and Tamil Nadu (amendments to Schedule I, 2023)

nodes.label: Registration Act: which loan documents must be registered
nodes.title: Registration Act, 1908: compulsory registration of documents affecting immovable property, time for presentation and the effect of non-registration
nodes.status: In force (as amended, with State amendments)

nodes.label: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam: electronic records as evidence
nodes.title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023: admissibility of electronic and digital records (ss. 61-63)

nodes.label: Bankers' Books Evidence Act 2026: certified copies of bank records
nodes.title: Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 2026: proof of entries in bankers' books, including electronic, offsite and cloud records

nodes.title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019: banking and financing as services, deficiency in service, unfair trade practices and consumer commissions
